title: API Key Generator
description: Generate cryptographically secure API keys with crypto.getRandomValues — hex, base64, base64url or UUID v4.
howto: Choose the format and the number of random bytes.
Generate one or many keys at once.
Copy them or download as a .txt file.

faqs.a: Yes — they come from crypto.getRandomValues, the browser CSPRNG, not Math.random.

faqs.q: What is the difference between base64 and base64url?
faqs.a: base64url replaces +/ with -_ and drops padding, making keys safe in URLs and filenames.
As true UUID v4: 128 random bits with the version and variant bits set per RFC 4122.
No — everything happens in your browser. Nothing is sent or saved.
